arms: ARM C: Thalamic HGG, DMG, DIPG and other rare CNS tumors not included in Arm A and B

coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult trial (6 months to 30 years; stdAges CHILD, ADULT). Glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels; only 'high grade glioma' (hemispheric/thalamic HGG, DMG, DIPG), so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Only intervention is a CAR T-cell product (excluded type). The lymphodepleting chemotherapy agents are not named, so not listed; the dimerizer AP1903 is given only to activate the suicide switch in case of toxicity and is not a registered intervention, so not listed. Three histology-defined experimental arms, none a control.
